name: Work the alert shift and see the linked incident
covers: deck navigation with Start the shift and First alert buttons
escalate and dismiss decisions on alert cards
What Northwall saw result card with score
description: Verifies a visitor can triage all ten alert cards and reach the result card that scores their decisions.
steps: Click the "Start the shift" button below the card
Click "Escalate" five times and "Dismiss" five times, alternating, until the ten alert cards are done
expected: A card titled "What Northwall saw" is shown with a score in the form "N / 5" and a green box reading "5 / 5"; the chapter list shows "Your shift 10/10".

name: Incident report writes itself and links to booking
covers: report cost line uses calculator inputs
report call to action opens the booking card
description: Verifies the incident report card finishes writing and its button opens the booking card.
steps: Click "Incident report" in the chapter list
Wait until the card header reads "filed"
Click the "Book a security review" button inside the report card
expected: The report shows a "Business impact" section mentioning "$316,800", and after the click the card titled "Book a security review" with a "Your name" field is shown.

name: Downtime calculator updates from visitor inputs
description: Verifies changing calculator inputs updates the total and the pricing estimate on mobile.
steps: Tap the "Downtime cost" chip at the top
Set Employees to 100, Revenue per hour to 5000 and Hours down to 10
expected: The downtime total reads $95,000 before switching, and the Pricing card shows "About $900 / month at 100 staff" for the Watch + Respond plan.

name: Booking form rejects missing details
description: Verifies the booking form blocks an empty submit and confirms a complete one.
steps: Tap the "Book a review" button in the header
Tap "Request my review" with all fields empty
Fill Your name "Sam Lee", Work email "sam@example.com", Company "Acme Freight" and tap "Request my review" again
expected: The first submit shows a message starting "Add your name"; the second shows "Request recorded" and the text "Thanks, Sam Lee".
